content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies, the wage amount or the application fee.

rows.details: Kerala Agricultural University, Agricultural Research Station, Anakkayam
Candidates with the qualification and age given in the notice (age 18-36 as on 01.01.2026)

content_sections.heading: About Agricultural Research Station, Anakkayam
content_sections.text: The Agricultural Research Station (Krishi Gaveshana Kendram), Anakkayam works under Kerala Agricultural University and is headed by a Professor and Head, Dr. Mustafa Kunnathadi, who signed the notice. The Skilled Worker is to be engaged at this station under its Revolving Fund Scheme. The station is in Malappuram district, Kerala.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites eligible candidates for one post, Skilled Worker, engaged temporarily for 1 year on a daily wage basis. Only candidates with the qualification prescribed in the notice are allowed to take the test or interview. Preference is given to candidates with work experience in labs such as tissue culture, biocontrol agents or mushroom production. If B.Sc Agriculture holders are not available, the following may also be considered, provided they have work experience in the fields named above: B.Sc–M.Sc (Integrated Biotechnology) from Kerala Agricultural University, or Diploma in Agricultural Science. The notice says any one of these will be considered in that case. The age limit is 18-36, counted as on 01.01.2026. Candidates from Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and other backward classes get the age relaxation allowed by rules; the notice does not print the number of years.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through certificate verification, a written test if needed, and an interview. The certificates of candidates are checked before the interview. If there are more applicants, a written test is held before the interview. Only candidates who get the prescribed marks in the written test are allowed to attend the interview. The notice does not print the pass mark or the syllabus. Only candidates who have the qualification prescribed in the notice are allowed to take the test or interview.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Original certificates proving educational qualification, age and experience. Copies of those certificates.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 10 AM on 17 November 2026 at the Agricultural Research Station, Anakkayam. Certificates are verified before the interview. A written test is held before the interview if there are more applicants.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is temporary, for 1 year, on a daily wage basis, under the Revolving Fund Scheme. Appointed candidates are not entitled to any service benefit of Kerala Agricultural University other than the wage stated in the notice. For details, candidates may call 04832848050. The notice also gives the email address [email protected] and the telephone number 0483-2848050. The notice is displayed on the notice boards of the farm and office, the State Seed Farm, Anakkayam, and Krishibhavan, Anakkayam, and is on the KAU website.
